SELECT
HOUR(reduce_date) as `name`,
DAY(reduce_date) as `name`,
MONTH(reduce_date) as `name`,
sum(num) AS `value` from consumable_reduce_record a inner join consumable_stock_detail b on a.id=b.stock_id where a.status='PASS' and reduce_date between #{date.startTime} and #{date.endTime}
GROUP BY HOUR(reduce_date) order by HOUR(reduce_date)
GROUP BY DAY(reduce_date) order by DAY(reduce_date)
GROUP BY MONTH(reduce_date) order by MONTH(reduce_date)

SELECT dept_id AS `name`, SUM(amount) AS `value` FROM consumable_stock_detail a INNER JOIN consumable_reduce_record b ON a.stock_id = b.id WHERE stock_flag = 'REDUCE' AND b.status = 'PASS' AND reduce_date BETWEEN #{date.startTime} AND #{date.endTime} GROUP BY dept_id

SELECT CASE WHEN stock > stock_max THEN 'stockMax' WHEN stock < stock_min THEN 'stockMin' ELSE 'consumableNumber' END AS status, COUNT(*) AS count FROM consumable where status = 'NO_DELETE' GROUP BY CASE WHEN stock > stock_max THEN 'stockMax' WHEN stock < stock_min THEN 'stockMin' ELSE 'consumableNumber' END
